not_r1: R4 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so it is a training-time privileged diagnostic: it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1) and no result here may be reported as R1.
declaration: R2 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so it is a training-time privileged diagnostic: it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1) and no result here may be reported as R1.

death_penalty.counted: once per death, a first death does not end the episode

progress_total.unit: reward for traversing the whole first face by score
progress_total.counted: cumulative, hard-capped at progress_total per episode

progress_score_full.event: the score a real first-face clear reaches

survive_per_decision.unit: reward per decision at the two-frame beat
survive_per_decision.role: explicitly zero in r2; the bounded survival constant ε in r3
survive_per_decision.event: every decision the engine is alive
survive_per_decision.counted: r2: 0.0, because at γ = 0.999833 (τ = 200 s) the discounted sum of a constant c is c/(1-γ) ≈ 6001·c and a long stall would out-earn a clear.  r3: ε > 0 but bounded by the declared assertion ε·T_max ≤ 0.25·progress_total, which the config validator recomputes and refuses to load without

first_life_per_decision.unit: reward per decision the first life is alive
first_life_per_decision.event: every decision taken while globals.deaths == 0, i.e. before the first death; a decision on which the first death happens still pays, because the life was alive when the action was chosen
first_life_per_decision.counted: per decision, hard-capped per episode at first_life_cap; δ is derived from first_life_cap / the measured clear length (6598 decisions), so the cap is reached exactly at a clear

first_life_cap.event: never paid directly; it caps the first-life term

power_gain.unit: reward per unit of power gained
power_gain.role: bounded power signal (r4 only), never a penalty
power_gain.event: globals.playerPower increases between two decisions (w_power x the positive increment)
power_gain.counted: only on the decisions whose power increment is > 0; a power loss is counted for the diagnostic and pays nothing, so the term is monotone and cannot be farmed by dying and re-collecting

power_max.unit: power units (the top of the TH08 scale)
power_max.event: never paid directly; it is the scale the bound is stated on
power_max.counted: once, at config load: power_gain x power_max <= 0.25 x progress_total, recomputed and fail-closed.  Power is an inventory, so the horizon does NOT multiply it (the r3 survival constant is per-decision and its own bound keeps T_max)

progress_bound.meaning: a trajectory can never earn more than progress_total from progress, however long it stalls

branches.1: P1 and P2 -> power is a survival bottleneck, keep adding
branches.2: P1 only -> power went up but survival did not improve -> power is not the bottleneck
branches.3: P2 only -> survival improved without learning to collect power -> another path
branches.4: neither -> the reward's blindness to power is not the cause

criteria.decisive_limit: the observation readability probe is half of this experiment: if R^2 < 0.5 on hud (1,56,160) or play (4,112,96), the observation does not carry power, so no reward term can teach it and a P1/P2 failure says nothing about the reward table

readability.instrument: real observations: the obs-v3 planes the policy receives, sampled on the same decision as engine-truth power (STATE player_power)
readability.probe: linear least squares with intercept + best single pixel, scored out of sample (odd/even split, both directions), with a 20-permutation null
readability.positive_control: power_band = screen rows 128-150, columns 480-640 (green channel), the region Gui.cpp:1348-1387 draws power in: if the probe cannot read power there either, the probe is broken, not the observation
readability.decisive_if_failed: R^2 < 0.5 on either policy plane means the observation cannot carry power, so an r4 power term cannot be learned regardless of its weight; that is a decisive limit of this experiment and it is reported as one

p1_behaviour.text: training-internal delta_power_per_episode(r4) is significantly greater than delta_power_per_episode(r3 control)

observed.metric: delta_power_per_episode = mean over episodes of sum(max(0, d power))

prediction.branch_text: P2 only -> survival improved without learning to collect power -> another path

hud.claim: a probe that cannot beat a time-shifted power series of the same smoothness is reading the clock, not the quantity

play.claim: a probe that cannot beat a time-shifted power series of the same smoothness is reading the clock, not the quantity

region.claim: the screen area whose pixels move when the engine's power moves, and whether the two observation crops contain any of it

control.background_note: pairs whose power did not move: this is what the scrolling background does on its own

attributed.claim: the part of the movement that is power-attributable rather than background scroll

panel_geometry.note: rows/columns of the right-hand panel (x 480-640) that change when power rises, per pair; the panel has no scrolling background, so this is the power readout itself

collected.controller: fixed script: 120 decisions up (cand 1), then sweep W/E every 25 decisions at the top (cand 7/3); shooting is always on in cand_to_mask, so items drop
collected.controller_note: a hovering controller collects nothing: an earlier run of 4 x 300 decisions cycling through all 18 candidates ended with power 0.0 throughout and could not answer the question at all, so the scripted sweep replaced it
collected.env: touhou_rl.v420.rl.GameEnv2F at the frozen two-frame beat, rollout.stage 0 / normal / team 0
collected.plane_provenance: hud/play are the obs-v3 planes taken from the environment's own observation dict; 'full' is the green channel of the same decision's 640x480 readback, and crop_consistency re-derives the planes from that readback with encode_planes_v3 to prove both refer to the same frame

pre_registered: the R2 floor 0.5 on each policy plane
at least 50 real samples with engine-truth power
observability_provenance.why: the pre-registered R2 gate did NOT fire: 0.6638 and 0.8373 are both above the 0.5 floor, so the confound controls were added after seeing that.  The decisive argument is independent of any data: the engine draws power at rows 136-151 / cols 488-616 (Gui.cpp:1348-1387) and neither observation crop looks there
observability_provenance.therefore: 'the observation cannot carry power' is established by the geometry plus the positive control plus the shift null, NOT by the pre-registered R2 < 0.5 route, and the report says so explicitly
